title: Cop Manuel Sandoval chases a disc from Cuba
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Cop Manuel Sandoval chases a disc from Cuba, about March 24, 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So when a disc comes wobbling low over Cuba that night, Sandival does the thing he'd been saying he would do. He goes after it all night.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a police officer named Manuel Sandoval in the small town of Cuba, New Mexico, on the night of March 24, 1948. According to Michels, a disc came wobbling low over the town, and Sandoval did what he had long said he would do: he chased it all night along Old Highway 44. The chase is part of a larger story of a craft said to have crashed into a nearby mesa, which would mean something unknown came down in New Mexico that year.
